name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes a 4-slot save-file picker UI (allocates render buffers, paints the slot grid, runs Up/Down navigation, returns 1=commit / -1=cancel). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Interactive 4-slot save-file picker UI: paints the slot grid with a 6-frame slide-down reveal, then runs an Up/Down navigation loop until the user commits (Enter/Space) or cancels (Esc).
logic_summary: Setup: __CHK(0x20); allocate 3 x 64000-byte render workspaces (a/b/c at [0x53C5B/5F/63]); snapshot the live VGA framebuffer (0xA0000) into b, clone into c; blit the panel-header sprite into c at +0x8C05 (sprite atlas entry at atlas[+0x46]); paint the initial slot grid into c keyed on data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx; play SFX 5 (panel-open chime); reveal the panel with a 6-frame slide-down (frame_iter 5..0, y = 0x70 + frame_iter*0xD). Input loop: if manual_mode==0, set key_input_mode=0x10 and read a key via BIOS int 16h (int386), folding extended/numpad scancodes 0xE0/0x52 -> 0x1C (Enter) and 0x53 -> 0x01 (Esc); else read via fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink(0). Down (0x50) when cursor!=3: SFX 7, cursor++, repaint grid. Up (0x48) when cursor!=0: SFX 7, cursor--, repaint grid. Enter (0x1C) or Space (0x39): result=1. Esc (0x01): result=-1. Loop exits when result!=0; returns result. The 3 workspace buffers are NOT freed here -- the caller frees them via fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out (shared 3-buffer state).

params.name: sav_decrypted_buf
params.semantics: Pointer (as uint32) to the plaintext (decrypted) FD2.SAV image; forwarded to fd2_render_save_slot_grid so each slot row can be summarized. Callers malloc(0x59CB), fread+decrypt or memset 0xFF, then pass it in.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate (decrypted FD2.SAV buffer); no address residue, not a generic param_N name.

params.name: manual_mode
params.semantics: Selects the input source: 0 = read keys directly via BIOS int 16h (with extended-scancode folding); nonzero = use the poll-and-blink helper fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink. Callers: continue-dispatcher passes 0, load passes 1, save passes prompt_flag & 0xFF.
params.reason: Not an address residue and not a generic param_N name; meaning (0 vs nonzero) is documented in the src comment. Slightly ambiguous as a name but adequate and consistent with caller intent (nonzero = interactive blink-cursor input), so no clear-improvement rename under the tightened criteria.

returns.semantics: 1 = user committed a slot (chosen slot index left in data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx, 0..3); -1 = user cancelled. Never returns 0 (the loop only exits once result is +/-1).

reads_globals: data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (@0x53C57) - slot cursor, read for highlight
data_fd2_audio_fdother_sfx_bank_buf_ptr (@0x53EEC) - SFX bank for panel-open (5) and cursor-move (7)
writes_globals: data_fd2_input_key_input_mode (@0x53A8E) - set to 0x10 before int 16h; folded to 0x1C/0x01 for extended scancodes
comment_original_issue: src comment (save.c lines 385-412) was already accurate, precise, ASCII, and free of phase/flux narrative; kept as-is.
notes: Ghidra plate updated: the previous plate grouped scancodes '0x52 / 0x53' together and claimed both fold to 0x1C / return 1, which is wrong -- 0x52 (and 0xE0) fold to 0x1C (Enter, commit) but 0x53 folds to 0x01 (Esc, cancel -> return -1). Plate now states the two foldings separately and matches the decompilation. src comment did not contain this error and was left unchanged. The src comment already documents the tail-JMP into the shared epilogue at 0x2D3F8 (MOV EAX,ESI / POP / RET) being equivalent to 'return result;'. No logic changes made.
